# GLFW public header

The unmodified `glfw3.h` header and license are from [GLFW 3.4](https://github.com/glfw/glfw/releases/tag/3.4). Only declarations are vendored; SpatialGL loads an optional GLFW shared library at runtime. The default simulator and headless raster path do not initialize GLFW.

Source archive: `https://codeload.github.com/glfw/glfw/tar.gz/refs/tags/3.4`

Archive SHA-256: `c038d34200234d071fae9345bc455e4a8f2f544ab60150765d7704e08f3dac01`
